text: I think you might be surprised by this recommendation, but hear me out. This marinade recipe doesn't actually contain any meat, as it's suitable for both pork chops and chicken. The ingredients are mostly plant-based, with soy sauce being a key component. Given your past preference for recipes featuring soy, I think you might enjoy this one. It's also quick to make and has a relatively low saturated fat content, which aligns with your nutrition pattern. Give it a try and see what you think!
